name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd. - Farm Equipment Sector
description: Mahindra is the world's #1 tractor company by volume, selling over 350,000 tractors annually. The Farm Equipment Sector (FES) manufactures tractors from 15 HP to 75 HP, farm implements, and agri-machinery. Manufacturing plants in Mumbai, Nagpur, Jaipur, Zaheerabad, and Rudrapur.
honest_assessment: Unbeatable for sub-50 HP tractors in India - widest dealer network (1,400+ dealers), excellent resale value, and strong government subsidy alignment. The Mahindra brand name carries tremendous trust in rural India. However, for specialized agricultural equipment (precision seeders, GPS-guided implements), they lag behind John Deere and CLAAS. Their 'after-market' parts are expensive - third-party alternatives exist but void warranty. Best for: small and medium farmers, fleet operators, government tenders.
address: Mahindra Towers, G.M. Bhosale Marg, Worli, Mumbai - 400018, India
